status_summary: ETA proposed on 2025-07-01 to remove the requirement that states use state merit staff for Wagner-Peyser Employment Service work, and on 2026-01-21 it delayed the 2023 rule's compliance date by one year to 2027-01-21. A final rule published 2026-08-20 (91 FR 54024) removes the merit-staffing provision in 20 CFR 652.215 so that each state may choose its staffing model, and it took effect on 2026-10-19. No court order, stay or later Federal Register document affecting the rule was found as of 2026-10-19, and codification by Congress was not found.

timeline.event: ETA published a proposed rule to remove the state merit staff requirement for Wagner-Peyser Employment Service staffing.
ETA delayed the compliance date of the 2023 merit staffing rule by one year, to 2027-01-21.
ETA published a final rule deleting the merit staffing requirement (20 CFR 652.215), effective 2026-10-19.
The ETA final rule Wagner-Peyser Act Employment Service Staffing (91 FR 54024) took effect on the date it set, removing the state merit staff requirement in 20 CFR 652.215.
